decision_rule.inconclusive: VALID_ABLATION_INCONCLUSIVE iff the frozen 40-pair schedule does not reconcile
decision_rule.no_signal: VALID_ABLATION_NO_SIGNAL iff difference < +0.05; the original +70 pp is treated as an OOD artifact
decision_rule.signal_present: VALID_ABLATION_SIGNAL_PRESENT iff PACT minus PACT_PERMUTED >= +0.10 and paired bootstrap 95% CI lower bound > 0; this clears Step 1
decision_rule.weak_signal: VALID_ABLATION_WEAK_SIGNAL iff difference >= +0.05 but signal-present rule is false; this does not authorize confirmation

primary_endpoint: task_success and hazard_bar contacts == 0 and other_environment contacts == 0
